question:
Between the circular plates of a parallel-plate capacitor (radius $R$), the electric field in the gap is **uniform** and varies with time as

$E(t)=\begin{cases}
E_0\dfrac{t}{T}, & 0 < t < T\\
E_0\left(2-\dfrac{t}{T}\right), & T < t < 2T
\end{cases}$

A circular loop of radius $r$ ($r < R$) is coaxial with the plates and lies midway between them. Choose a fixed loop orientation so that the sign of $B(t)$ is defined consistently.

Which option correctly gives $B\left(\tfrac{T}{2}\right)$ and $B\left(\tfrac{3T}{2}\right)$?
